name: 72904 · Fort Smith, AR
findings: ZIP 72904 (Fort Smith) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72904 (Fort Smith) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 9% of all organizations here have no identified type.
